_: G22: the standing and in-between Mixamo captures baked for the character on the Mixamo Standard Skeleton (web/room/char_mixamo.glb), one row each; standing_rebake.sh builds them all into web/room/mx_standing/<Clip>.glb (+ standing_clips.meta.json). kind: standing = on his feet (the lowest sole soleUp over the floor, planted stances held); seated = in OUR desk chair throughout (G12's fit: the thighs on the cushion, seatGap from its top, feet planted on the floor by leg IK); transition = both, blended by how low the hips are, the cushion stopping the hips whenever they are over the seat. seatOrigin: the seated hips at the clip's origin (the page puts it on the chair's seat point). trim [from, to] s: only that stretch (Sit_To_Stand runs on past the act: G12). hold: what the hands hold (phone = the page's phone, on the right hand; tablet / controller: a socket only, no prop in the page). spot: where ?char=mixamo&clip=<Clip> shows it (rug: on his feet in the open middle of the room, on the rug, facing the window; chair: the desk chair rolled back from the desk by the clip's own reach).
